description: Fully remote via the MPCDF LLM Inference Service (llm.mpcdf.mpg.de) on your own MPCDF account. Log in with your MPCDF username, password and one-time code in the account card of the Configure preset dialog, which starts the embedding and LLM endpoints (re-ranking starts from its own tab); each runs as a job (up to 8 hours, renewed while in use) on your account. Currently slow: the service's embedding and re-ranking endpoints take about 50 seconds per request, so a query takes one to two minutes and re-ranking runs past its time limit (the query then goes on without it).
